answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with decay-weighted reputation: standing comes only from verified useful work and fades unless fresh work refreshes it, so a cloned army cannot bank one good deed and coast forever. Each clone must keep producing real value or its earning power drains to zero, making mass cloning a treadmill, not a shortcut. Standing must pass three checks - the meadow check on the work, the lagoon check on the verifier, and the echo check on the decay schedule.
